body:
Suresh, here's the first cut of the corporate thali — edit anything:

Mylari Corporate Thali — offices near Indiranagar (suggested pricing, edit freely)
• 10+ thalis a day: ₹134 each (10% off your ₹149 walk-in)
• 25+ thalis: ₹127 each (15% off) + free delivery
• 50+ thalis: ₹119 each (20% off) + monthly billing
• Order by 11am on WhatsApp, delivered by lunch

At ~18 thali orders a day now, a single 25-plate office order more than doubles weekday lunch. You already pull 12,400 profile views and 88 calls a month — this puts the new offer in front of every office team searching for lunch near Indiranagar. Ise Google post + office admins ke liye 3-line WhatsApp mein badal doon? Bas YES bhejiye.
rationale: Merchant already expressed intent — skip qualification, hand over a complete, editable artifact built on their live offer price (proposals labelled as suggestions), tie it to their own reach, then one publish CTA. Levers: effort externalization, momentum. Facts: trigger.payload.intent_topic + merchant_last_message; merchant.offers (live thali price); merchant.performance; merchant.conversation_history (orders/day).

Kids Yoga Summer Camp — Zen Yoga Studio, Mylapore

Wahi dose, wahi brand — pack karne ke liye taiyaar. Dhyan dein: is mahine atorvastatin ke kuch batch voluntary recall mein hain (CDSCO alert Apr 2026) — dawa ki taakat ka mamla hai, suraksha ka nahi — hum sirf safe batch se hi denge. Senior citizen 15% chhoot lagegi, aur ₹499 se upar free home delivery saved address par. Bhejne ke liye HAAN likhiye, ya dose mein koi badlav ho to bata dijiye.
rationale: Chronic refill: exact molecules and run-out date, only the pharmacy's live perks, a recall cross-check against this week's digest, and a respectful family-channel address in the customer's language. Levers: precision, trust, low friction. Facts: trigger.payload molecules + runout date; category.digest[d_2026W17_atorvastatin_recall] cross-check; merchant.offers (senior, delivery).

On IPL Saturdays, restaurant covers ran 12% below a normal Saturday (magicpin order data, Apr 2026) — a Sunday match keeps people home the same way. Your 'Buy 1 Pizza Get 1 Free (Tue-Thu)' doesn't run tonight anyway — keep it for the next weeknight match. Play delivery instead — tonight people order in, they don't walk in. Match se ek ghanta pehle a delivery-only version of the 'Match-night Combo @ ₹399 (food + drink)' + Insta story live kar doon? YES bhejiye, 10 min mein kaam ho jayega.
rationale: Weekend match (payload is_weeknight=false): covers fall on weekend match nights, so the bot recommends against the obvious dine-in promo, notes the live weekday offer can't run tonight, and redirects to delivery. Levers: contrarian judgment, specificity. Facts: trigger.payload match; category.digest[d_2026W17_ipl_window]; category.offer_catalog (match-night combo).
